title: unified-rollouts: automated rollback workflow for shadow/canary/A-B deployments
author: Priya Nair
description:
Motivation: We need a single, safe automated rollback workflow that covers progressive canary, A/B, and shadow deployments under the unified rollouts framework. Previously we had separate best-effort scripts and ad-hoc heuristics; this PR implements a first-class, policy-driven autorollback engine that integrates with rollout controllers, observability, and runbooks.

What this PR does: Adds a rollback engine and associated controller hooks that: 1) consume metric alerts and composite signals from the observability pipeline, 2) evaluate rollback policies (multi-metric thresholds, policy hysteresis, minimum sample windows), 3) sequence rollback steps by rollout type (canary -> reduce traffic; A/B -> reassign traffic; shadow -> stop shadowing), and 4) emit detailed events and tracing for the Console. The engine supports safety guards (cooldowns, rate-limited rollbacks, manual approval gates), and a simulation mode for dry-run validation.

High-level changes included: new runtime rollback engine, rollout controller wiring, policy schema extension, observability rule adapters, e2e and integration tests, Console UI additions for rollback insights, and updated docs + runbooks.

Testing & validation: unit tests for policy evaluation, integration tests for canary/A-B/shadow rollback flows, e2e against perf-canary harness to verify stability under load. CI includes simulated noisy metrics to ensure policy hysteresis behaves correctly.

Rollout plan: Deploy to staging behind feature flag; run a set of synthetic regressions and flaky metric injections; enable for a small percentage of customers in Dedicated for two weeks with automatic telemetry dashboards.

Checklist: - [x] Design doc reviewed (ENG-4123) - [x] Unit + integration tests added - [x] e2e tests (perf-canary) added - [x] Console UI surface for rollback events - [x] Docs + runbook updated - [x] Feature-gated in config by default off

Notes: This PR intentionally keeps the rollback decisions declarative and separate from scheduling/traffic logic to make future A/B experimentation and multi-variant rollouts easier to plug in.
commits: feat(rollouts): add rollback engine core and policy evaluator
chore(schema): extend rollout policy schema for multi-metric thresholds
feat(controller): wire rollback engine into rollout controller events
feat(observability): adapter for composite metric alerts to rollback engine
test: add unit + integration tests for autorollback
review_comments:
Ethan Cole: Overall looks good. Two requests: (1) add a guard so rollback can't happen if rollout age < min_sample_window, (2) make the cooldown configurable per-policy.
Author (Priya): Added both guards and default cooldowns in policy schema; updated tests.

Aisha Chen: We need stronger observability for false positives. Suggest including a composite metric that requires both error-rate and latency regressions.
Author (Priya): Implemented composite_adapter that can require conjunctive conditions; added e2e case where latency spikes alone do not trigger rollback.

Tomás Rivera: Console UI looks good, but UX says show timeline with linked traces. Can we emit an event with trace_id?
Author (Priya): Rollback events now include optional trace_id when available; Console renders link to trace viewer.

Ethan Cole: CI noted a flake in integration test with simulated jitter; added deterministic seed.
Author (Priya): Fixed seed and retried CI.
release_notes: Adds a policy-driven automated rollback engine for unified rollouts (canary, A/B, shadow). Includes policy schema for multi-metric thresholds, safety guards (cooldowns, minimum sample window), Console rollback events and traces, and test coverage. Feature gated and off by default.
extra_notes: Backported hooks are small and documented in docs/runbooks/rollback_workflow.md; ops playbook includes steps to disable autorollback if noisy signals are observed.
